title: Crossing the Road
scene: 走去学校，过马路左右看、走人行道、等红灯
theme: 上学路上，过马路要小心〔对话〕

patterns.template: Look left and right before you ___.

sentences.text: Stop, Ana! Do not walk into the road.
sentences.gloss: 停下，安娜！别走到马路上去。
sentences.speaker: Ben

sentences.text: I want to cross to the other side.
sentences.speaker: Ana

sentences.text: Not here. This street is dangerous, and the danger is the cars.
sentences.gloss: 这里不行。这条街很危险，危险来自那些车。
sentences.speaker: Ben

sentences.text: We cross at the corner. Look at the traffic light.
sentences.gloss: 我们在拐角过。看那个红绿灯。
sentences.speaker: Ben

sentences.text: It is red now, so we wait.
sentences.gloss: 现在是红灯，所以我们要等。
sentences.speaker: Ana

sentences.text: Yes. We wait for the green light, and then we walk.
sentences.gloss: 对。我们等绿灯，然后再走。
sentences.speaker: Ben

sentences.text: Look left and right before you cross. Be careful!
sentences.gloss: 过马路之前先看左看右。小心！
sentences.speaker: Ben

sentences.text: Hold my hand. That car is slow, but it does not stop. Now we are on the sidewalk, and we are safe.
sentences.gloss: 抓着我的手。那辆车开得慢，但它不停。现在我们在人行道上，安全了。
sentences.speaker: Ben
